source_file.Description: Original NWB file (DANDI 000623 asset path) from which the recording was converted; byte-identical copy under sourcedata/dandi-000623/.

source_sha256.Description: SHA-256 of the source NWB file, equal to the DANDI asset digest dandi:sha2-256.

source_first_lfp_timestamp_s.Description: starting_time of processing/ecephys/LFP_macro/ElectricalSeries in the source NWB, in the source LFP clock whose zero is 10 s before movie onset.
